item.title: Slider 1.5 RC1 (18)
item.description:
Slider 1.5 RC1 (18)

  • New look: Frosted White style with a soft grey nav in light mode. A permanent deck details panel replaces the card grid, row toolbar and Details window. Decks now always open by their exact file path or URL, so same-named decks never open the wrong file. Sets and Tags are now sidebar items, and Tags lets you filter by several tags at once. Settings has a cleaner, native layout.
